name: Intercom
description: The Intercom MCP Server gives your AI tools access to customer data—conversations, tickets, and user data. This lets teams across your business, not just support, use that data in their workflows: from spotting bugs and shaping the product roadmap to refining messaging and preparing for QBRs. Every team can act with clearer visibility into what customers need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Intercom to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Intercom to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.intercom.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Intercom MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Intercom provides these MCP tools: search, fetch, search_conversations, get_conversation, search_contacts, and get_contact.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Intercom?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Intercom in customer-support on the Manufact MCP catalog include Assembled, Brainfish, ClearFeed, Conduit, and DevRev.
Intercom requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Intercom is developed by Intercom. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
